items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: I grew up of a similar generation to Mike Holober and Maria Schneider... And of course Maria came in a year after me.

ctx.x: It’s the real thing. And I wondered if you’ve transitioned from the pencil and score to Finale or whatever?

Oh boy you’re asking such great questions. Yeah I have a million pencil scores lying around here I could hold up as my prop. Yeah I’m something of a — I don’t want to say — I’m not a troglodyte, maybe a Luddite is a better word. I grew up of a similar generation to Mike Holober and Maria Schneider and you know various people who still need to have the pencil on the paper. And you know the various modes now where people like obviously Maria and you know Mike, they can get their music copied if it’s a project for…
It’s a deep dive and the thing about Finale that I’ve discovered is that it’s hard to stop fussing with it.
